cluster.headline: Netanyahu accused of helping Kushner conceal a billion dollars from the UAE - report
cluster.body_note: Paywalled/truncated; only lead available via WebFetch. Based on investigation by journalist Matthew Cole, excerpted from his book 'Princes and Thieves', published by Vanity Fair, reported via Ynet. Claims: network of bank accounts gave Jared Kushner ~$2B from Gulf countries; in 2018 UAE's Mohammed bin Zayed reportedly sent ~$1B to Israel routed through Azerbaijan; Netanyahu allegedly urged Kushner to deposit funds in a Bank of Israel account so they'd appear as government assets; Dutch intelligence allegedly monitored Kushner's phone, found a UAE account funded by hundreds of millions from Saudi/Emirati sources. Kushner's lawyer denies the accounts existed. No primary document linked in accessible text.
